english.title: With intent to deceive forge a goods vehicle operators licence / document / plate / qualification certificate / diploma

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Goods Vehicles Licensing of Operators Act 1995

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), with intent to deceive, forged

(A)_[an operator's licence]_
(B)_[a document, plate, mark or other thing by which a vehicle is to be identified as being authorised to be used, or as being used, under an operator's licence]_
(C)_[a document evidencing the authorisation of a person for the purposes of sections 40 and 41 of the Goods Vehicles (Licensing of Operators) Act 1995]_
(D)_[a certificate of qualification under section 49 of the Goods Vehicles (Licensing of Operators) Act 1995]_
(E)_[a certificate or diploma such as is mentioned in paragraph 13(1) of Schedule 3 to the Goods Vehicles (Licensing of Operators) Act 1995]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 38(1)(a) and (3) of the Goods Vehicles (Licensing of Operators) Act 1995.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See section 38(4) for meaning of "forge".
(ii) Section 51 provides an extended time limit for bringing summary proceedings by applying section 6 of the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
(iii) See also offence wordings: H821 and H822.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex - see legislation

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
